entities.summary: Amy Bowtell is a former tennis player and former Irish number one. Her highest WTA singles ranking is No. 381. Bowtell won ten professional titles, five singles and five doubles titles on the ITF Women's Circuit. She has been a member of Ireland Fed Cup team since 2009.
